subject: Post-call: Meditech audit-trail delivery plan and format questions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@meditech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + audit-trail delivery plan (next steps)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the audit-pack request into engineering:

What we discussed
- Scope: who/what/when access audit for the Redwood inference service for a 90-day rolling sample window (you flagged 2027-01-01 — 2027-03-31 as the initial sample).
- Fields you need: user_id (internal), actor_email, action_type, resource_id, resource_type, timestamp (UTC), client_ip, request_id, model_id, request_payload_hash (optional).
- Residency: export must be delivered to an EU-hosted S3 bucket (you mentioned Frankfurt).
- Delivery: presigned S3 upload or SFTP; encrypted at rest and in transit.
- Redaction: PII must be redacted unless we have explicit legal agreement (you requested examples of what we can provide).

Proposed next steps / owners
1) You: confirm the exact date range for the first export and provide the S3 bucket details or SFTP credentials (owner: Meditech).
2) Laura Bennett / Redwood Legal: confirm whether a limited DPA addendum is required before we include any user-identifiable fields.
3) David Kim / SRE: prepare a sample export (1 day) in Parquet and CSV so you can validate schema and column formatting. I attached a short delivery checklist and a Parquet sample we typically send.
4) Jordan: coordinate timeline — target sample delivery: 48-72 hours after bucket details and DPA confirmation.

Questions we still have
- Do you need timezone normalization to the source local time or all timestamps in UTC?
- Is request_payload_hash sufficient in place of payload body for forensics?
- Any additional attribution fields (session_id, application_id) you require?

Attachments: Meditech_Audit_Request_Form.pdf (your fillable form), redwood_log_schema_parquet_sample.parquet (schema example), redwood_delivery_checklist.csv

If that looks good I’ll loop in engineering and legal and schedule the export.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0179

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@meditech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@meditech.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:33:12 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + audit-trail delivery plan and format questions

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Couple clarifications from our side:

1) Date range: please start with 2027-01-01 through 2027-03-31 as discussed. We may ask for rolling exports after validation.
2) Residency: yes — exports must land in our EU tenant (Frankfurt, eu-central-1). We will provide a cross-account write role and temporary credentials; otherwise SFTP with public key is acceptable.
3) Fields: list looks good. For PII we can accept hashed email (sha256) and the clear user_id only if we have a signed DPA addendum. Otherwise please return user_id redacted and include an internal anonymized_id that we can map after DPA.
4) Format: Parquet preferred for the full export, but please also include a one-day CSV sample for quick inspection.
5) Delivery schedule: target is within 5 business days after we confirm the delivery method and DPA status.

I attached the completed Meditech_Audit_Request_Form.pdf (filled) with our preferred S3 role name and a point of contact for our infra team (Carlos). Carlos will be the technical contact for S3 exchange.

Samantha Lee
Senior Compliance Manager, Meditech Solutions
samantha.lee@meditech.com

--- attachment: Meditech_Audit_Request_Form.pdf (fillable) ---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + audit-trail delivery plan and format questions

Team —

Quick legal checklist before we deliver any e2e-records to an external tenant: 
- Need a signed DPA addendum that explicitly authorizes delivery of user-identifiable fields (user_id, actor_email). If Meditech insists on user_id in cleartext we need Legal approval + security review.
- Confirm acceptance of hashed identifiers (sha256) in lieu of clear PII; require mapping key exchange protocol if/when PII is requested later.
- Confirm retention limits (how long will Meditech keep the export). We should add a clause that Meditech verifies deletion at retention expiry.

David — please prepare a one-day extract sanitized for PII (replace actor_email with hashed_email, remove request body). Also include column-level encryption metadata.

Jordan — I’ll draft the DPA addendum template and send to Samantha for signature; please include the specific column list we will consider 'PII' so Legal and Compliance have exact fields called out.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@meditech.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@meditech.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:47:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + audit-trail delivery plan and format questions

Samantha / Carlos —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the filled form. We’ll proceed as follows:

1) Legal: Laura will send the DPA addendum by EOD (Jordan will share the exact PII column list to be included).
2) Infra: David will produce a one-day sanitized sample (Parquet + CSV) within 48 hours and upload to your provided S3 role. We will include a small README with schema and example queries.
3) Delivery: full 3-month export will be produced once DPA is signed and you confirm the S3 role details. For large exports we prefer Parquet partitioned by date; we’ll include a manifest.csv listing files and checksums.

Open items for your reply
- Confirm you want timestamps normalized to UTC (recommended) or local timezone.
- Confirm whether you accept hashed_email (sha256) instead of actor_email until DPA is in place.

If you’re happy with that plan we’ll kick off the sample job tomorrow morning and share a hard ETA.

Best —
Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
